'''Dreviad Outpost''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:DW" /> It was located in the [[Dreviad Wastes]],<ref name="TOR:DW" /> within the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]],<ref name="TOR:DR">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Dry Run|Tatooine}}</ref> close to [[The Wound]].<ref name="TOR:DW" />

A [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] named [[Tookreek]] owned a [[Tookreek's Cantina|cantina]] in the outpost.<ref name="Bugged-Out">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Bugged-Out|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dreviad Outpost was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Republic settlements on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:DO" />
